title: Issue Bias in Generative AI Writing Assistance: Political Issues and LLMs in the Swedish 2026 Election
abstract: arXiv:2609.15207v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative AI writing assistants and the Large Language Models (LLMs) that power them are increasingly part of how voters gather information before elections. With growing evidence that they influence users' opinions, it is increasingly important to understand the views and positions of these tools. To better understand these views, we examine the stances supplied by six LLMs on a variety of Swedish-language writing tasks ahead of the 2026 Swedish parliamentary election. We cross 107 policy propositions with 77 writing templates and neutral, positive, and negative prompt framings, producing 24,717 prompts per model and 148,302 responses. To study these, we look at the models' default stance tendencies, compare how they respond to similar issues, and compare their responses with those of each of Sweden's eight parliamentary parties on the same issue. translated_title: 生成式AI写作辅助中的议题偏见：2026年瑞典大选中的政治议题与大语言模型
translated_abstract: 生成式AI写作助手及其背后的大语言模型（LLMs）日益成为选民在大选前获取信息的途径之一。随着越来越多的证据表明这些工具会影响用户的观点，理解它们所持的观点和立场变得愈发重要。为了更好地理解这些观点，我们研究了六个大语言模型在2026年瑞典议会大选前针对各类瑞典语写作任务所给出的立场。我们将107项政策提案与77个写作模板以及中性、正面和负面三种提示框架进行交叉组合，为每个模型生成24,717个提示，共计148,302个回复。为开展研究，我们考察了模型的默认立场倾向，比较它们对相似议题的回应方式，并将它们的回应与瑞典八个议会政党在同一议题上的立场逐一对比。我们发现Claude、DeepSeek、Gemini和Mistral具有相似的立场特征；而ChatGPT则更……
tldr: 该研究通过组合107项政策提案与77个写作模板生成超过14.8万个提示，系统分析了六个大语言模型在2026年瑞典大选相关议题上的立场偏见，发现Claude、DeepSeek、Gemini和Mistral的立场特征相似，并将其与瑞典八个议会政党的立场进行了对比。
